record.field: Standard template for sleeve/sheet garbage bags. Supports: tie band, flexo print, HDPE/LDPE/LLDPE resin. O-variants: ink (activated when has_print=true). Ad-hoc: tie band (injected when has_tie=true).

record.field: Full PoliGroup wizard matrix. Uses bags_extended design.param.definition. T0: dimension + gusset constraint validation. T1: material_width by construction/gusset_mode; bag_weight_g with/without cord; roll/box/pallet weights; per-ton counts. T2: packaging material qty_expr (roll core, box, pallet) by packaging_mode. T3: Extrusion (always), Confection (always), Flexo Print Inline, Flexo Print Confection, Cord Insertion, Packaging.
